mapper.select: SELECT cr.roomIdx, cr.roomName, ( SELECT content FROM ( SELECT content FROM chatMessage WHERE roomIdx = cr.roomIdx ORDER BY msgIdx DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ) AS recentMessage, 0 AS unreadCount FROM chatRoom cr WHERE cr.roomType = 2 ORDER BY cr.roomIdx ASC

SELECT u.userIdx, u.userId, u.name, u.nickname, u.profile_photo, a.authority FROM users u JOIN userAuthority a ON u.userId = a.userId WHERE a.authority IN ('ROLE_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'ROLE_EMP', 'EMP') ORDER BY u.userIdx ASC
